title: VPORT/VIEW ambient color-book name TABLES callback budget boundary
scope: Close the full TABLES callback-publication gap for retained DXF group-431 names in VPORT and VIEW
Verify one-byte-under refusal, exact-cap retry on the same facade, and a following table-record sentinel
Use existing hardening test owner and avoid external or committed fixtures

method.kind: Extend the existing generated DXF retained-string budget test and run focused validation
method.limitations: Generated controls establish only the bounded DXF TABLES callback/refusal/retry path for VPORT and VIEW group 431. They do not test DWG string accounting, rendering, reference graph semantics, native acceptance, or support claims.

assessment.planImpact: Closes the callback-boundary test gap inside existing 7S.2c.d.17.64 using the current hardening target. No production implementation change or new CTest registration was needed.

implementationReadyChecks: Use separate minimal AC1027 TABLES inputs for VPORT and VIEW so an earlier table cannot publish callbacks before the tested refusal point.
For ASCII and Binary DXF, establish the minimum successful full-read budget, refuse at one byte below it before callbacks, then retry on the same facade at the exact cap.
Require the target record and following same-table sentinel to be published in order with their group-431 values intact.
Keep the Binary DXF in temporary storage only and remove it; do not add a sample or a new CTest target.
Keep the result limited to DXF retained-string/callback behavior; DWG strings and external/native evidence are separate gates.
